seoDescription: About Manchester River Cruises — sightseeing cruises, events and private hire on the Manchester Ship Canal from Salford Quays. Meet our fleet and the team behind the boats.
intro: Sightseeing cruises, events and private hire on the Manchester Ship Canal — here's the story behind the boats.

sections.heading: Our story
body: Manchester River Cruises was founded to bring river tours to the heart of Manchester, operating from Salford Quays. We're passionate about the city's waterways and the history written along the Manchester Ship Canal.
sections.note: Full company story — TBC from Simon (content-checklist.md).

sections.heading: Our fleet
body: Meet the boats that carry you along the water. Each has its own character; full details and passenger capacities live on our vessels page.

sections.heading: Meet the team
body: Behind every cruise is a small, dedicated crew — skippers, hosts and the office team who keep the boats running and the welcome warm.

strings.value: Two smiling Manchester River Cruises crew members behind the boat's bar, spirits and optics lined up on the wall behind them
